proposal.observation: detected_lines.png shows all 10 vertical ring boundaries (magenta) recovered, consistent with ring_count_error=0, but oblique line yield is very low: only 3 positive (green) and 3 negative (red) oblique segments, all confined to the right-most ~3 rings (x~1700-2400, y~1450-1650), plus a single short horizontal fallback line near (2300, 800). The binarised outlier map itself shows the joint-mark rows (y~1350-1750) present across ALL ten ring columns, just sparser on the left, so the joint evidence exists in the depth/outlier map but is not being converted into Hough lines. initial_prompt_points.png shows all 10 prompt centres at an identical y~1550 tagged 'propagated', i.e. only one locus was actually detected and the rest were replicated. depth_map_viridis.png has holes concentrated in the top band and along the mid-height joint row, but the lining body is largely filled; depth_nan_ratio=0.165 and sam_fill_rate=0.767 are acceptable, so the dominant deficit is correspondence_f1@15=0.172.
proposal.rule: d7 (stage_4_detection): m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines. Upstream precondition check: joint marks are visible in every ring column of the outlier map and depth holes are moderate, so f_joint_oversmoothed / f_depth_holes are not the primary cause; remediation r_relax_hough applies (lower oblique Hough threshold, raise maxLineGap, admit more outlier pixels via a lower binary threshold).
proposal.rationale: The proxy's weakest term is correspondence_f1@15; the prompt centres are propagated from a single detected locus, so any lateral drift of true joints across rings is not captured, and SAM crops land slightly off-segment (f_crop_offset via f_pattern_mismatch). Relaxing only the oblique HoughLinesP path (threshold toward the low end, larger maxLineGap) and lowering the binarisation threshold should let the sparser left-side joint dots form oblique segments per ring, giving per-ring intersections instead of propagated ones. Vertical Hough, pattern_tolerance, denoising, enhancing and SAM stages are left untouched because ring count is correct, fill rate is healthy, and stage 1 is locked. Values are chosen moderately (not at the extreme 20/60) to avoid the spurious-line regime seen in worked example g005 (hough_oblique=22 combined with binary_threshold=150 and vertical=822 collapsed f1 to 0 as a joint outcome); here binary_threshold is lowered rather than raised, and the vertical accumulator is not changed.
